# dsh-sidecar-conversation
**Don't understand part of an AI answer? Ask beside it, without cluttering your main Session's conte
't understand part of an AI answer? Ask beside it, without cluttering your main Session's context.**
In DeepSeek Harness Web, select unfamiliar text and ask for an explanation in the native right sideb
ar. Follow-up questions and explanations stay in their own Session, without being written back into
your main conversation. You can also ask about a whole turn or fork from an earlier point, with sepa
rate messages, drafts, model and permissions.

## 0.2.8: native list and permission lifecycle
The full native session list is now the default. Its rows, workspace management, search, pinning and
archiving remain owned by DSH. Use the footer toggle for the optional collapsible Sidecar view; an
explicitly saved choice is preserved.
Unsent sidecars no longer occupy reusable workspace blanks. Ordinary New Session therefore keeps nat
ive permission defaults instead of inheriting an old sidecar's settings and showing Custom. First-tu
rn attachment and legacy blank recovery preserve native logs and permissions.

## Watch the 90-second demo
Watch on Bilibili: real multi-turn conversations in an isolated environment, showing Fork, reference
s-only Sessions, appended references, precise source navigation, native composer controls and histor
y recovery. The full page stays visible, with red circles marking the focus. Waiting is edited out;
some operations are sped up, with AI voice narration.
## What you can do

- **Explain part of an answer:** select unfamiliar text and ask about it with a source reference.
-
**Continue an existing Sidecar:** append new text or a whole-turn reference to the most recently use

d Sidecar without losing its draft question.
- **Explore another direction:** fork an earlier turn's

context while the main conversation continues its work.
- **Start with references only:** create an
independent Session containing explicit references and your question, without inheriting the full c
Session containing explicit references and your question, without inheriting the full conversation.
The right-hand chat uses DSH's native composer: file uploads, model and reasoning selection, permiss
ion controls, messages, tool calls, approvals, stop and error displays. A Sidecar supports continued
conversation across multiple turns.

## From references to continued conversation

1. Select text or a turn on the left, then choose append, independent creation or Fork.
2. Edit your
question on the right and choose files, model and permissions as needed. Add references from the le

ft one at a time, or remove individual draft references.

## Check DSH compatibility before installation
Version `0.2.8` uses public DSH APIs and its unified list was verified against unmodified DSH `0.2.1
-rc.3`. No DSH source patch or Better Sidebar installation is required:
- `sidebar.session.row.leading` / `sidebar.session.row.hover`: existing public row decorations; titl

es remain native.
- `sidebar.workspaces` / `shell.overlay`: the public slot ledger supplies the exis
ting root view-store handle; the plugin renders the unified list and reuses native preferences and o
rdering actions, without a second order store.
All Sidecar extensions live in the plugin; no DSH source patch or custom `uiWorkspace.sessionOrder`
/ `sidebar.workspaces.session.title` service is needed. A public sidebar slot supplies a collapsible
Session tree from the plugin registry, including on rc.3 where ordinary Fork logs omit parent links
. Independent chats remain roots. Native titles, order data, composer and session logs remain author
itative. The full native list is the default: DSH owns row rendering, search, ordering, pinning, arc
hiving and workspace management. A persistent footer toggle opens the plugin's collapsible hierarchy
view. That optional view uses native state and actions but still renders its own rows; it needs com
patibility testing when DSH changes. No private row imports or DSH patches are used.
Unsent independent sidecars keep their native Session and logs outside workspace membership until th
eir first native turn starts. This prevents native New Session from reusing a reserved blank with si
decar permissions. Recovery also detaches legacy blank sidecars without rewriting permissions or del
eting logs; they remain accessible through sidecar history. Ordinary new sessions retain DSH's nativ
they remain accessible through sidecar history. Ordinary new sessions retain DSH's native defaults.
